clips.title: The story
paras: At the Shrine of the Dormant Flame, Horde shaman seek communion with fire atop Durotar’s highest peak northwest of the Valley of Trials. Telf Joolam keeps the secluded sanctuary, where initiates climb to prove their spiritual mastery.

A narrow trail winds up from the Southfury River, at the southwestern edge of the Southfury Watershed. The summit rises above Durotar’s red cliffs, with a commanding view and a precipice where one misstep means certain death. Telf Joolam, a solitary hermit, oversees the sacred rites here. Aspiring orc and troll shaman come for the ritual Call of Fire. At the shrine’s brazier, they use the ember of a defeated elemental to kindle the sleeping coals and prove they can commune with fire and respect its destructive spirits.
